items.name: AirLLM (lyogavin) — streamed large-model inference / streamed LoRA on limited VRAM
items.verdict_reason: Owner supplied the repository for Office v2 intake. AirLLM offers layer/expert streaming when a model exceeds GPU VRAM and may serve as an offline local inference fallback. The upstream VRAM feats do not establish usable latency; published Windows/NVIDIA and AMD complaints plus extreme MoE token times require objective comparisons with existing local serving. Registered for read-only research and isolated, lease-gated same-task benchmarking, not for installation or promotion.
platform_constraints: Research reviewed v4.0.0 (2026-09); license for the project code is Apache-2.0. Each model's weights/license, dependency versions and permitted use must be checked independently.
Peak VRAM figures are NOT throughput: the Kimi K3 release reports ~292 seconds per token on RTX 6000 Ada while checkpoint files consume ~1.56 TB; a practical offline workflow must be demonstrated.

Open upstream report #364 measured 28.6 s/token for 3B on Windows/NVIDIA with NVMe; #301 reports AMD/ROCm Windows generate problems. They are third-party observations, not reproduced measurements on any Velvet host.
Open upstream issue #330 contests the older claim that blockwise 4-bit/8-bit compression yields up to 3x speedup; do not assume compression improves throughput on our machines.

Layer split can temporarily require both original model checkpoint and re-sliced copies. Verify independent disk/RAM/IO budget, model revision, teardown/rollback, and resource owner before any weight download.
Do not preempt #612 coding-agent, Studio/LOCAL3D/Genex, or #604 fleet resources. No automatic GPU, WSL/OS install, paid API, production server, public listener, credential or customer-data access.
notes: OWNER LINK 2026-10-13: https://github.com/lyogavin/airllm, manually captured in canonical Office v2 intake; no automated ChatGPT→registry bridge is implied.

CURRENT KNOWN INCUMBENT: Studio previously used local Ollama/loopback qwen3.5:9b on Chris; live process/port/GPU state is UNKNOWN for this intake. Per-host capability inventory must precede selection.
COMPETITION-NEUTRAL: evaluate Ollama/llama.cpp quantized and CPU/GPU offload, existing Transformers, and Mac/MLX when appropriate; do not reject AirLLM solely because a local LLM engine is installed.
SCOPE: potentially replace one inference component or add a selectively invoked offline oversize-model backend; not a full Office, orchestration, TTS, coding-agent or printer replacement.
PHASE NOW: source/license/compatibility review and synthetic fixture design. FUTURE: gated isolated same-workload benchmark only after hardware/disk/resource and existing service-owner verification.

TEST: tokens/s, TTFT, cold-start, quality, memory and storage high-water marks, disk throughput, CPU/GPU load, costs and rollback; separate quality differences caused by model quantization from engine performance.
NO RUNTIME ACTION: no model downloaded, no local AirLLM process run, no GPU leased, no network endpoint provisioned, no production permission changed.
Upgraded in place from the auto-placeholder. Draft id candidate-lyogavin-airllm is not registered.

comparison_review.next_action: In Phase 2, verify current per-host model serving inventory and upstream version/license/Windows issues, define isolated 27B/32B oversize-model benchmark with synthetic CAD/code/Hebrew tasks and storage/throughput budget. When a genuinely independent host lease and model rights are available after the relevant #612/#604 gates, benchmark pinned AirLLM against verified existing quantized/offloaded inference and record a decision before any deployment.
comparison_review.rationale: Streaming permits otherwise VRAM-infeasible models but can transfer a huge amount of data for every token. It deserves a fair targeted offline comparison against existing smaller faster quantized systems, not incumbent veto nor an automatic replacement.
